body:
Sustained mobile Doc typing can exceed the unchanged 100 ms native flush maximum when a 32-state cache contains an Enter followed by plain append edits. This change balances only a fully qualified final append run, preserves the structural head, and reuses the successful qualification within that call.

## 🚧 Current validation candidate

- Source: `02ef01a40fe8369b79477909673c76de6d2a4edf`; base: `2f442317dd2e1c188ae4a810ac094fd1162a4a2a`; branch: `codex/spn-146-mobile-flush`.
- **Draft; current-head hosted acceptance remains pending.** The previous source's application CI passed, but its component experiment failed analysis and had inconclusive timing. Neither result is reused as acceptance for this changed candidate.
- SPN-141 → SPN-140 → SPN-120 and SPN-089 remain blocked on accepted SPN-146. SPN-143/PR #263 and SPN-144/PR #265 are merged. No foreign branch was taken over; future takeovers must satisfy the owner's two-hour branch-age rule and ownership check.
- Complete scope remains XL. **Agent review only.** No visible product change or visual-approval claim.

## 🔎 Behavior and regression contract

Only descriptor-safe data, one native Enter with its matching style retain, and at least four contiguous plain append states on the same unit/segment qualify. The complete graph guard remains intact. The revised composer reuses already-qualified ranges, retaining the original initial-null head fold for prefixes 0–3 and the identical balanced-prefix/Enter/tail operands otherwise. Undo, unsupported shapes, metadata, accessor/error behavior, grouping, ownership and all product budgets remain unchanged. Exact previous native patches remain hash-verified install upgrades and work negatives.

Actual-manager tests cover ES/CJS, all 32 Enter positions, both retain modes, nonzero offsets, unequal queues, metadata, full snapshots and output ownership. New controls compare every primitive operand's value, input/result identity and call order, and prove the old source fails the reduced-work assertion. Full application checks still own 2,086 inputs, history, saved/live content, access, IME, reconnect and native browser behavior. Emulated mobile is not a physical-phone claim.

[Maintained implementation and decisions](https://github.com/mxbaylee/spinel/blob/02ef01a40fe8369b79477909673c76de6d2a4edf/docs/implementation/SPN-146.md).

## 🧪 Current local evidence and one prospective runtime check

- A fixed 16-flush comparison on retained actual inputs preserved raw publications and primitive work in every pair. Prefix/delete qualification calls each fell 8→4; shape checks fell by 644 and descriptor visits by 108; full admission remained twice. The 338 ms probe-body time includes setup/assertions/serialization and is not a native latency measurement. Parent: 833 ms, 270224 KiB, normal pressure.
- Adopted native ES/CJS SHA-256: `110890e889ac362b22a4c38bafd1ebb4e7cf82e8107d4524bdb86ff7fe6bd7c3` / `58edceea5e1fb66ff1a83ec0a92707cf6f8d741aab87eb922d9c7e021f99207d`.
- All 204 manager tests passed: 19490 ms, 559456 KiB. All 26 runtime/ownership/evidence controls passed: 184 ms, 90864 KiB. Scoped TypeScript, lint, PR backlog and official actionlint v1.7.12 passed; shellcheck/pyflakes integrations were disabled. An initial type error in the trace-context test was fixed by declaring the existing optional `args` field; the failure and repair remain retained.
- Preparation passed: 1102 ms, 618848 KiB, same 888-module/15-package read-only donor closure and frozen browser body. This is local working-tree preparation, not a full local app installation or hosted acceptance. The previously unusable partial Playwright installation remains disclosed; clean hosted CI owns broader application suites.
- The changed reader retains instant/flow/nestable-async GC records as duration-unknown context. They never supply pause duration or replace the separate duration-bearing GC control. Unknown/malformed forms and incomplete/mismatched synchronous intervals fail. A regression read of the original retained trace found 96 intervals and 1078 context records and still requires precisely the original **8/16 inconclusive** outcome. No browser or converter reran for this regression.
- Independent archive verification checked all 90 new retained payloads, exact sets, stored/decoded hashes and six current source bindings: 289 ms, 92720 KiB, normal pressure. The archive writer's self-log was captured empty while open and its archived watchdog was only a ready snapshot; neither supplies acceptance credit. Independent verification is retained separately.

[Qualification, tests, source bindings and preparation](https://github.com/mxbaylee/spinel/blob/02ef01a40fe8369b79477909673c76de6d2a4edf/docs/implementation/evidence/SPN-146/qualification-reuse/manifest.json).

**Explicit new experiment on changed code:** one first-attempt synchronization away from published `483bf8ae4609fa8027485293e6050fe8dca88e1c`. Same four retained cache pairs, 32 observations, both manager formats/orders, 4× CPU, frozen body, shared ES Core and controlled sinks. Every one of 16 matched comparisons must still improve by **both ≥20% and ≥1 ms** against the original-main native baseline. Strict full protobuf, pinned Perfetto v59.1, all 194 marks/single-renderer clock spread ≤0.25 ms, raw parity/nonmutation and owned cleanup remain required. Setup 8 minutes; job 15 minutes; each preparation/observation/conversion phase 60 seconds, 2 GiB owned RSS and 1 GiB host MemAvailable. Pauses are never subtracted. Later pushes/edits and workflow reruns cannot renew this allowance. Mixed effects or missing/failed evidence stop it. No automatic third experiment follows.

This asks about the complete revised candidate's guard-inclusive benefit. Comparing separate runs cannot isolate the incremental timing contribution of qualification reuse or explain the historical uncaptured maxima. Fresh selected application/native CI remains an independent merge requirement.

## ⚠️ Original Linux result remains failed and inconclusive

On `483bf8ae4609fa8027485293e6050fe8dca88e1c`, [component run 42006109881](https://github.com/mxbaylee/spinel/actions/runs/42006109881), job127173148420, attempt1 completed all 32 observations, complete strict protobuf and pinned conversion/cleanup. Observation parent: 12099 ms / 1849660 KiB. The analyzer failed `Unsupported GC representation` on valid context records. This was not transport loss or a resource abort.

The independent timing result was **8 comparisons meeting both thresholds, 3 improving too little, 5 slower**. No averaging, sample removal, pause subtraction or threshold relaxation changes it. CPU evidence has 80 negative deltas and a 700.1 ms startup bracket; no exact per-window sampled cost is claimed. Static source inspection plus the subsequent lower-layer counterfactual justified investigating duplicate qualification; the mixed timing alone did not.

[Complete original artifact, identities, raw/converted traces, failed analysis and both dispositions](https://github.com/mxbaylee/spinel/blob/02ef01a40fe8369b79477909673c76de6d2a4edf/docs/implementation/evidence/SPN-146/linux-runtime-outcome/manifest.json). Artifact13405220484 ZIP:2365966 bytes, SHA-256 `7242949d61d77c447c2eb2887af4d0c155fa2579b43d30874c3521e93faaee83`; all contents are preserved independently of Actions expiry.

Earlier failures remain preserved in the maintained record: original unprofiled maxima 129.1/114.4 ms on SPN-089 and 116.5/122.3 ms on SPN-141; dedicated diagnostic41992099001 failed strict trace completion with uncaptured completion flags; the local browser phase aborted at pressure2 before any observations; workflow42004830910 failed parsing with zero jobs. None became a pass. The current source corrects trace rejection telemetry and the workflow environment context while preserving the original receipts and no-repeat dispositions.

## ✅ Previous source's application acceptance — historical only

Source `483bf8ae4609fa8027485293e6050fe8dca88e1c`, tested merge `853de9794611bbe56c55429a349cef4b7dcbc8fa`, identical tree `02fe8769b8b3b6568fd9356cfd7adf6d661654d1`:

- [CI42006109864](https://github.com/mxbaylee/spinel/actions/runs/42006109864), attempt1: all33 jobs / all7 required gates passed.
- [Storybook42006109837](https://github.com/mxbaylee/spinel/actions/runs/42006109837), attempt1:8 successes,2 inapplicable Pages skips.
- [Native42006109796](https://github.com/mxbaylee/spinel/actions/runs/42006109796), attempt1: Chrome/Firefox/Safari passed37/37/39 stages.
- Mobile plain1/2/3 capacity p95:23.3/23.3/19.7 ms; maxima:27.4/50.3/28.0 ms; idle maxima:3.3/1.8/2.3 ms. Plain1 actually traversed all66 Undo/Redo groups; other plain/profile cases traversed one each. Exact integrity and both responsiveness comparisons passed. Desktop capacity maxima:7.7/9.2/9.3 ms. Both callback comparisons accepted without failures.

[Durable application evidence](https://github.com/mxbaylee/spinel/tree/1bd21a6b009da5f1b72ecae07844f83e743eebab/docs/review-assets/spn-146-first-linux-app-483bf8ae) preserves full native/responsiveness archives, run/job/tested identities and callback reports. Full callback raw traces/maps remain supplementary local ZIPs and artifacts13405961161/13405590934 expiring2026-11-12; summaries are not called complete traces. Earlier source1eeb90f1's passes remain in the maintained first-candidate manifest. No historical pass substitutes for current-head acceptance.

Superseded runs42004793620,42004840062,42004839728,42004839916 and metadata42006100854 are confirmed terminally cancelled. Their cancelled/missing selected work and consequent aggregate failures are not application acceptance. Any metadata validation triggered by publishing this description will be identified and intentionally cancelled separately from the useful new code run.

## 👀 Exact-head independent reviews

Both nonimplementing reviewers assessed `02ef01a40fe8369b79477909673c76de6d2a4edf`: A **98/100** (35/25/18/10/10), B **97/100** (35/25/18/9/10). No unresolved source blockers. The scores permit only the declared validation publication; current hosted benefit and full acceptance remain pending. Findings about archive self-log/watchdog and earlier builder-receipt provenance are explicitly disclosed; neither is misrepresented as completed current acceptance.

# 🔎 SPN-146 exact-source pre-push review A

**Reviewed commit: `02ef01a40fe8369b79477909673c76de6d2a4edf`. Base: `2f442317dd2e1c188ae4a810ac094fd1162a4a2a`. Independent score: 98/100. No unresolved source blocker found; this head qualifies from reviewer A for the single declared validation publication. It is not merge-ready or runtime-accepted.**

Read-only review in `/Users/mxbaylee/projects/spinel-spn-146`; verified the clean exact head. Read the original base ticket, process/testing/personas and runbook rubric, complete change inventory and current repair diff; reassessed the full original outcome and reused the previously inspected unchanged implementation with its original evidence identities. Reread the composition/admission/upgrade paths, meaningful new tests, runtime builder/analyzer/runner/watchdog/converter, workflow boundaries, callback ownership/trace changes and harness routing. Prior grades were not treated as this head's grade.

## 📊 Independent rubric

- **Scope and acceptance: 35/35.** The XL outcome retains the real mobile capacity/idle limits, all native content/history/access owners and the causal-evidence obligation. The failed initial diagnostic, local resource abort, workflow parse failure and original mixed Linux result remain distinct. The new experiment has an explicit changed-candidate hypothesis, finite allowance and unchanged success criterion. Conditional landing bookkeeping does not claim GitHub acceptance or completion.
- **Correctness, integrity and access: 25/25.** Full graph/metadata/offset admission is unchanged. Qualification reuse preserves the composition tree and null-accumulator boundaries; unsupported and undo paths remain unchanged. Exact prior-build upgrades remain guarded. Diagnostic machinery is opt-in; ordinary application permissions, sharing and native budgets are not relaxed. Owned trace collection and first-failure/cleanup handling remain intact.
- **Meaningful protection and evidence: 18/20.** Strong deterministic controls, exact retained inputs, current source bindings and failed-result preservation support this source assessment. Deduct two points for the still-unestablished guard-inclusive runtime benefit and current-head clean-install/application integration: donor-based local verification and work counts cannot answer those questions. Required disposition is the already declared hosted experiment plus fresh selected acceptance, not additional synthetic tests or a weaker threshold.
- **CI and operations: 10/10.** One exact before-head transition, same-repository owning branch, first attempt and reviewed-head checkout are enforced. Resource/closure checks and terminal failure behavior remain bounded. Stable seven-gate routing and applicable browser/native owners remain mandatory. Actionlint evidence addresses the previous context-validation miss.
- **Maintainability, process and over-complexity: 10/10.** The production repair reuses an existing range composer and adds no general optimizer, cache, package or public bypass. The sizable diagnostic/evidence surface is justified by the retained XL runtime question and failure ownership; it does not create ordinary production work. Exact historical upgrade forms and failed artifacts are necessary provenance, not speculative flexibility. No actionable simplification was found that safely preserves those obligations.

## ✅ Important source conclusions

At `scripts/dependencies/patch-univer-docs.ts:312`, the adopted helper replaces only the already admitted paragraph-tail recursion. Prefixes 0–3 retain the sequential null head through Enter; larger prefixes retain balanced prefix plus Enter; the qualified tail retains its balanced tree before the final join. Complete generated hashes match the reviewed prototype: ES **110890e889ac362b22a4c38bafd1ebb4e7cf82e8107d4524bdb86ff7fe6bd7c3**, CJS **58edceea5e1fb66ff1a83ec0a92707cf6f8d741aab87eb922d9c7e021f99207d**. The former paragraph-tail hashes remain exact upgrade inputs and work negatives, including unknown-edit rejection.

The tests at `scripts/dependencies/patch-univer-docs.test.ts:1521` compare primitive operand snapshots, input/result identities and call order across both modes, all 32 positions and both directions; require reduced checks only for admitted redo tails; and require unchanged checks otherwise. They complement existing manager publication, raw metadata, mutation/alias, unequal-cache and fallback controls. No claim that structurally compared prototype snapshots alone establish prototype-reference identity is needed.

At `scripts/ci/doc-native-runtime/analysis.ts:111`, category/name selection retains known instant, flow and nestable-async records separately as duration-unknown context. They cannot substitute for the positive duration-bearing GC control, alter measured times, or justify pause subtraction. Unknown phases, malformed context and unmatched/unclosed synchronous intervals fail. The reader discloses nested-span and outside-window-endpoint limits, and makes no absence-of-GC claim. The declared phase distinction agrees with the pinned [Chromium trace types](https://chromium.googlesource.com/devtools/devtools-frontend/+/b88894b14f63f84c460f66cff8918b2b4d079eae/front_end/models/trace/types/TraceEvents.ts); those format authorities are not asserted to be the exact executing browser revision.

The changed builder binds both new native hashes, original-main baseline and old candidate, the frozen browser body and four actual input pairs. The reviewed workflow admits only the transition away from `483bf8ae4609fa8027485293e6050fe8dca88e1c`; later edits/pushes or a workflow rerun do not renew it. All 16 matched comparisons must still improve by at least 20% **and** 1 ms. A same-baseline comparison can assess total new-candidate benefit; separate runs cannot isolate the incremental timing contribution of qualification reuse.

## 🧾 Independently checked evidence

One authorized serial/watchdog verification passed first execution: **289 ms, 92,720 KiB peak observed RSS, normal pressure**. It verified exact directory membership, every stored and decoded SHA-256/byte count for **90 payloads**, and all **six current source bindings**. Outcome evidence: 31 payloads, 1,911,857 stored / 3,502,267 decoded bytes. Qualification evidence: 59 payloads, 1,210,102 stored / 14,450,790 decoded bytes. It also verified runner, watchdog, converter, diagnostic observer, evidence bridge and native spec are unchanged from the last reviewed published source.

Proof is retained externally as `/tmp/spn146-qualification-prepush-proof-a.ts`, `.json`, `.log` and `-watchdog.json`. No browser, converter, benchmark or test suite was rerun by A. The retained original ZIP's bytes are preserved; this scan did not reparse its entire inner trace or substitute a new native audit.

Read the hash-verified local receipts: **204/204 manager tests** passed (19,490 ms / 559,456 KiB observed), **26/26 runtime controls** passed (184 ms / 90,864 KiB), scoped manager types/lint and final runtime types/lint passed, actionlint and exact-title backlog validation passed. Short compiler receipts are sampled process observations, not guaranteed compiler peak memory. The matched preparation retains 888 modules/15 packages and the exact new hashes; its source field is the then-current base HEAD with separately bound working-tree bytes, explicitly not a claim that the new commit ran in a browser. The donor bridge changes import resolution only and the clean hosted install remains pending.

The changed-reader regression retained the original **8/16 inconclusive** outcome, 96 intervals and 1,078 duration-unknown records; it does not replace the original failed analyzer receipt. The prior first type failure and corrected final types remain retained.

## 📋 Findings and dispositions

1. **No new blocking source finding.** Earlier duplicate-qualification, preparation identity/primary-error and trace-context issues are addressed on the reviewed bytes with meaningful controls.
2. **Nonblocking evidence-retention limitation, accepted with explicit disclosure:** `receipts__qualification-retention.log.gz` is an empty snapshot taken while its writer was open; its archived watchdog is a `ready` snapshot, not terminal success. Neither supplies acceptance credit. The parent disclosed the separate terminal receipt, and this review's independent complete hash proof verifies the final retained set. Do not describe the archived self-log/watchdog as a completed check.
3. **Acceptance remains a merge blocker:** no current-head hosted positive component outcome or full clean-install seven-gate/native acceptance is credited. The prior experiment remains failed/inconclusive; first-candidate green application checks are not current-head passes. A mixed/failed new result exhausts this allowance and requires a new explicit disposition, not an automatic third experiment.

All four personas remain covered: Owner gets exact saved content and real history protection; Collaborator gets independent publication/ownership and reconnect boundaries; Link guest retains revocation and access checks; Operator gets bounded resource ownership, immutable failures and guarded dependency upgrades. No physical-device claim or visual redesign is introduced.

Landing preparation preserves next ID 147 and grooming date, records 21 completed-since entries/22 open tickets in the generated index, removes only SPN-146 and updates SPN-089's prerequisite wording. These are prepared changes, not proof of an accepted ticket. Before merging require both independent qualifying grades on the final source, every selected current-head check, an honest runtime/causal disposition, preserved final evidence and fresh base/head guards. Any further source or bookkeeping change requires exact-head revalidation.

# 🔎 SPN-146 independent pre-push review B

Reviewed exact commit **02ef01a40fe8369b79477909673c76de6d2a4edf**, tree **95df0cb77e8d509f3150ea7a1a48342cbb4c37e1**, against original-ticket base **2f442317dd2e1c188ae4a810ac094fd1162a4a2a**. The worktree was clean. This is a nonimplementing, agent-only source review, with the complete base-to-head outcome and the substantive delta from published **483bf8ae4609fa8027485293e6050fe8dca88e1c** considered. No application, browser, converter, native diagnostic or test rerun was performed for this review.

**Score: 97/100. Ready for the one declared validation push, subject to the separate second exact-head review. Not merge approval. No unresolved source blocker found.**

## 📏 Independent rubric

- **Scope and acceptance: 35/35.** The original XL ticket still owns the failed 100 ms mobile maxima, complete content/history/access contract, native cost versus runtime-pause distinction and final first-attempt acceptance. The record preserves the failed capture, resource-aborted local attempt and failed/inconclusive Linux experiment. It does not substitute counts or later green application checks for the remaining guard-inclusive runtime question. Conditional ticket/index/dependency landing bookkeeping remains contingent on actual acceptance.
- **Correctness, integrity and access: 25/25.** The new production success path reuses qualification inside one call while preserving the full graph/descriptor guard, admission boundary, primitive composition tree, tiny-head initial-null fold and unsupported/undo fallback. It adds no persistent classification cache or authority change. Exact old and new ES/CJS builds remain recognized upgrades; arbitrary edits remain rejected. Existing persistence, collaboration and guest access boundaries are untouched and remain acceptance obligations.
- **Meaningful verification: 18/20.** The retained actual-manager evidence covers 204 controls, including every Enter position, both modes/directions, exact primitive operand values and input/result identity/order, raw outputs, ownership, metadata, unequal caches and unsupported/accessor fallback. The 16-flush probe proves duplicate work removal, not latency. Twenty-six runtime controls and the original-trace regression prove that the new reader retains the original 8/16 inconclusive outcome. Deduct two points because the revised candidate's guard-inclusive native cost and complete current-head first-attempt application/native acceptance remain unobserved; resolve with the declared finite experiment and required selected gates, not extrapolation from these local results.
- **CI and operations: 9/10.** The same-repository exact branch/before-SHA synchronization route admits only the transition away from 483bf8ae; reruns fail the attempt guard and later updates do not renew it. Exact checkout, source/dependency identities, finite setup/job/phase bounds, resource guards and owned cleanup remain intact. Deduct one point for pending execution of the revised build/trace-reader integration on hosted Linux. The older hosted green checks and prior successful transport/conversion are historical evidence only.
- **Maintainability, process and over-complexity: 10/10.** The production repair is a small replacement of redundant recursive qualification, using the existing composer rather than adding a new abstraction. Preserving exact former patch forms is necessary for safe upgrades and negative controls. The diagnostic machinery is substantial but has a concrete finite causal question, shared collector/progress ownership, bounded resources and a declared closure condition; no speculative flexibility or avoidable new framework warrants a deduction. Documentation distinguishes the two experiments and retains their failures. No new UI design or visual-review obligation is introduced.

## 🧩 Source and semantic findings

The successful Enter-tail branch now directly composes the ranges already admitted by `canComposeDocParagraphTail`. For prefix lengths below four it preserves the old sequential fold beginning at null; otherwise it preserves the balanced prefix followed by Enter, then the balanced tail and final join. The complete whole-state plain-data/descriptor check and every metadata predicate remain unchanged. The new operand-trace controls verify this equivalence rather than merely comparing a final string. Old-candidate count controls demonstrate that the intended reduction would fail on the previous implementation.

The reader distinguishes synchronous duration-bearing GC-associated spans from instant, flow and nestable-async context. Every context record and its arguments remain available, including endpoints outside measured windows. Known context cannot satisfy the duration-bearing forced-GC control. Unknown phases, malformed context, mismatched or unclosed synchronous spans still reject. Nested durations are not summed as total pauses, context distances are not converted to duration, and no GC absence or pause-subtracted improvement is claimed. These distinctions agree with the [pinned Chromium phase definitions](https://chromium.googlesource.com/devtools/devtools-frontend/+/b88894b14f63f84c460f66cff8918b2b4d079eae/front_end/models/trace/types/TraceEvents.ts); that is format authority, not an assertion of exact runtime revision.

The proposed new 32-case experiment is justified by a real candidate change demonstrated at the lower layer. It keeps the original-main baseline, four retained cache pairs, orders, frozen browser body, throttle, resource limits and requirement that all sixteen comparisons improve by both at least 20% and 1 ms. It tests the complete revised candidate; without a third arm it cannot isolate the incremental runtime contribution of qualification reuse. It cannot explain historical maxima. A failed, missing or mixed result must stop this allowance; no automatic third experiment or unchanged rerun is admitted.

## 🧾 Evidence integrity and limits

I independently matched all six final source bindings in `qualification-reuse/manifest.json` to this checkout, and verified stored/raw hashes for selected adopted-identity, manager, final controls, final types, workflow, trace-regression and retention receipts. Reviewer A separately completed the bounded complete 90-payload exact-set/hash scan; I did not duplicate that workload. Retained logs show 204 manager controls and 26 final runtime controls passed. New native hashes are ES `110890e889ac362b22a4c38bafd1ebb4e7cf82e8107d4524bdb86ff7fe6bd7c3` and CJS `58edceea5e1fb66ff1a83ec0a92707cf6f8d741aab87eb922d9c7e021f99207d`.

The earlier adopted-identities receipt contains an earlier builder hash; the final manifest independently binds the revised current builder. It is historical provenance, not a current-builder pass. Scoped donor-based types/preparation are not full clean-install application validation. The archived `qualification-retention.log` is zero bytes because it was captured while its writer remained open; it supplies no successful check evidence. This disclosed self-log limitation does not invalidate independently hash-bound payloads or the actual test receipts. The retained first type failure and repaired final result remain distinct.

Run 42006109881 on 483bf8ae remains failed/inconclusive: strict capture/conversion succeeded, its original analyzer rejected the representation, and raw timing independently satisfied only eight of sixteen comparisons. Reading its unchanged trace with a repaired parser is a regression check, not replacement acceptance. Parent-reported completion of 483bf8ae's 33 application jobs, Storybook and native owners supplies no current-head gate credit.

## 👥 Persona decision and remaining gate

Owner retains exact content and full history while seeking responsive typing. Collaborator retains publication order and shared state. Link guest retains edit/view/revocation fences. Operator retains bounded memory/process ownership, complete failure provenance and a finite investigation rather than repeated acceptance attempts. The chosen source change is proportionate for all four; controlled component sinks still exclude full application subscribers, which remain owned by ordinary current-head application acceptance.

Before merge, obtain and independently audit the one declared changed-candidate runtime result, all seven exact-head gates and every selected native/application/Storybook owner under unchanged first-attempt contracts. Preserve full original failures regardless of subsequent outcomes, reconcile fresh main/source identities and durable evidence, and complete ordinary branch cleanup only after actual landing. This report permits source validation publication only; SPN-146's causal/runtime acceptance and downstream SPN-141/SPN-120 merge objective are not complete.
